verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software product or API platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Its online investor-readiness tool and downloadable cap tables are client resources, not a developer API. The OpenAPI probes returning 404 confirm the absence but do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
